# Contributing

Before a pull request, run both checks:

    python3 check_style.py
    python3 -m unittest
files.check_style.py:
import pathlib
import sys

long = [f'{path}:{number}' for path in sorted(pathlib.Path('.').glob('*.py'))
        for number, line in enumerate(path.read_text().splitlines(), 1) if len(line) > 100]
for place in long:
    print(f'{place}: a line over 100 characters')
sys.exit(1 if long else 0)
